# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Unregistered source-only template; active workflow must be byte-identical.
name: PCIe complete-record recovered-clock CDC proof
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      execute:
        description: 'Execute the reviewed complete functional proof after controls'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      diagnose:
        description: 'Execute only the reviewed collector-reset targeted baseline/fault diagnostic'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
concurrency:
  group: pcie-gen12-record-cdc-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  source-controls:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact source, thirteen real supervision fixtures and strict result classification
        env:
          REQUEST_COMPLETE: '${{ inputs.execute }}'
          REQUEST_DIAGNOSTIC: '${{ inputs.diagnose }}'
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          a=os.environ['REQUEST_COMPLETE'];b=os.environ['REQUEST_DIAGNOSTIC']
          assert a in ('true','false') and b in ('true','false')
          assert not (a=='true' and b=='true'),'Choose exactly one native purpose'
          PY
          python3 -u scripts/check_pcie_gen12_record_cdc_cloud.py | tee cdc-controls-console.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          r=json.loads(Path('hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc/controls.json').read_text())
          assert r['status']=='PASS_CDC_CONTROLLER_SOURCE_AND_CLASSIFICATION_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert r['classification_control_count']==63 and len(r['controls'])==63
          w=r['collector_reset_witness_controls']
          assert w['status']=='PASS_LITERAL_PUBLIC_COLLECTOR_RESET_GUARD_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert len(w['positives'])==2 and len(w['rejected'])==26
          assert all(x['rejected'] for x in w['rejected'].values())
          assert w['wrong_mutant_refusals']==34 and len(w['actual_guard_sites'])==2
          assert w['priming_assertions_unqualified'] and w['generic_timeout_unqualified']
          assert w['simulations_executed'] is False
          t=r['collector_reset_targeted_controls']
          assert t['status']=='PASS_TARGETED_PUBLIC_RESET_ADMISSION_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert len(t['positives'])==4 and all(t['positives'].values())
          assert len(t['rejected'])==32 and all(x['rejected'] for x in t['rejected'].values())
          assert t['simulations_executed'] is False and t['synthetic_fixtures_not_native_evidence']
          assert all(x.get('passed')is True or x.get('rejected')is True for x in r['controls'].values())
          q=r['qualified_supervision_controls']
          assert len(q['controls'])==13 and all(q['controls'].values())
          z=r['bounded_memory_sampler_controls']
          assert z['status']=='PASS_BOUNDED_FRESH_MEMORY_SAMPLER_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert len(z['positives'])==15 and all(z['positives'].values())
          assert len(z['rejected'])==27 and all(v['rejected'] for v in z['rejected'].values())
          assert z['real_churn']['samples']>=3 and z['real_churn']['maximum_observed_members']>=2
          assert not z['real_churn']['cleanup']['remaining_live']
          assert r['simulations_executed']is False and r['synthesis_executed']is False
          assert r['terminal_source_pins_unchanged']is True
          p=r['publication_controls']
          assert len(p['release']['rejected'])==17
          assert len(p['wait']['positive_cases'])==3 and len(p['wait']['rejected'])==4
          assert p['archive']['negative_controls']==6 and p['archive']['positive_roundtrip']
          assert p['readonly_program']['actual_extracted_program_positive']
          assert len(p['readonly_program']['rejected'])==3 and not p['readonly_program']['network_or_upload_executed']
          PY
      - name: Preserve complete small source-control result in bounded log chunks
        if: always()
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --log-controls
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: gen12-record-cdc-controls-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc
            cdc-controls-console.log
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn
  complete-functional-proof:
    needs: source-controls
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.execute && !inputs.diagnose
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bounded exact tools, two RTL simulators, mapped oracle and eighteen compiled faults
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: |
          python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --native | tee cdc-native-console.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          r=json.loads(Path('hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc/result.json').read_text())
          assert r['status']=='PASS_RECORD_CDC_66_RTL_33_MAPPED_18_COMPILED_FAULTS'
          assert r['engineering_accepted']is True and r['terminal_source_pins_unchanged']is True
          assert len(r['rtl'])==12 and sum(len(x['tests'])for x in r['rtl'])==66
          assert len(r['mapped'])==6 and sum(len(x['tests'])for x in r['mapped'])==33
          assert all(t['disposition']=='PASS'for x in r['rtl']+r['mapped']for t in x['tests'])
          assert len(r['synthesis'])==6 and all(x['full_synth_and_check']for x in r['synthesis'])
          assert len(r['mutations'])==18 and len({x['mutation']for x in r['mutations']})==18
          assert all(x['compile_returncode']==0 and x['run_returncode']!=0 and
                     sum(t['disposition']=='DETECTED_ASSERTION'for t in x['tests'])==1 for x in r['mutations'])
          assert all(value is False for value in r['scope'].values())
          PY
      - name: Preserve complete small result before artifact upload
        if: always()
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --log-result
      - name: Publish exact-source summary and complete verified evidence parts
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --publish
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: gen12-record-cdc-proof-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc-publication
            cdc-native-console.log
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn
  collector-reset-diagnostic:
    needs: source-controls
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.diagnose && !inputs.execute
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Targeted public reset baseline on both simulators, mapped oracle and compiled fault
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: |
          python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_collector_reset_diagnostic.py --native | tee collector-reset-native-console.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          r=json.loads(Path('hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-collector-reset-diagnostic/result.json').read_text())
          assert r['status']=='PASS_TARGETED_PUBLIC_COLLECTOR_RESET_WITNESS'
          assert r['targeted_witness_accepted'] is True and r['terminal_source_pins_unchanged'] is True
          assert r['engineering_accepted'] is False and r['complete_CDC_accepted'] is False
          assert len(r['rtl'])==2 and {x['simulator'] for x in r['rtl']}=={'icarus','verilator'}
          assert len(r['mapped'])==1 and r['mapped'][0]['simulator']=='icarus'
          assert len(r['synthesis'])==1 and r['synthesis'][0]['full_synth_and_check']
          assert sum(len(x['tests']) for x in r['rtl']+r['mapped'])==15
          assert all(t['disposition']=='PASS' for x in r['rtl']+r['mapped'] for t in x['tests'])
          assert all(len(x['public_reset_witness']['samples'])==4 for x in r['rtl']+r['mapped'])
          assert len(r['mutations'])==2 and {x['simulator'] for x in r['mutations']}=={'icarus','verilator'}
          assert all(x['mutation']=='collector_reset_POR_only' and x['compile_returncode']==0 and
                     x['run_returncode']!=0 and
                     x['public_reset_witness']['status']=='OBSERVED_MUTANT_PUBLIC_RESET_VIOLATION' and
                     len(x['public_reset_witness']['samples'])==1 for x in r['mutations'])
          assert all(value is False for value in r['scope'].values())
          PY
      - name: Preserve complete small result before artifact upload
        if: always()
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_collector_reset_diagnostic.py --log-result
      - name: Publish exact-source summary and complete verified evidence parts
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_collector_reset_diagnostic.py --publish
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: gen12-collector-reset-diagnostic-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-collector-reset-diagnostic
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-collector-reset-diagnostic-publication
            collector-reset-native-console.log
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Unregistered source-only template; active workflow must be byte-identical.
name: PCIe complete-record recovered-clock CDC proof
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      execute:
        description: 'Execute the reviewed complete functional proof after controls'
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
concurrency:
  group: pcie-gen12-record-cdc-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  source-controls:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact source, thirteen real supervision fixtures and strict result classification
        run: |
          python3 -u scripts/check_pcie_gen12_record_cdc_cloud.py | tee cdc-controls-console.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          r=json.loads(Path('hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc/controls.json').read_text())
          assert r['status']=='PASS_CDC_CONTROLLER_SOURCE_AND_CLASSIFICATION_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert r['classification_control_count']==63 and len(r['controls'])==63
          w=r['collector_reset_witness_controls']
          assert w['status']=='PASS_LITERAL_PUBLIC_COLLECTOR_RESET_GUARD_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert len(w['positives'])==2 and len(w['rejected'])==26
          assert all(x['rejected'] for x in w['rejected'].values())
          assert w['wrong_mutant_refusals']==34 and len(w['actual_guard_sites'])==2
          assert w['priming_assertions_unqualified'] and w['generic_timeout_unqualified']
          assert w['simulations_executed'] is False
          assert all(x.get('passed')is True or x.get('rejected')is True for x in r['controls'].values())
          q=r['qualified_supervision_controls']
          assert len(q['controls'])==13 and all(q['controls'].values())
          z=r['bounded_memory_sampler_controls']
          assert z['status']=='PASS_BOUNDED_FRESH_MEMORY_SAMPLER_CONTROLS_NO_RTL'
          assert len(z['positives'])==15 and all(z['positives'].values())
          assert len(z['rejected'])==27 and all(v['rejected'] for v in z['rejected'].values())
          assert z['real_churn']['samples']>=3 and z['real_churn']['maximum_observed_members']>=2
          assert not z['real_churn']['cleanup']['remaining_live']
          assert r['simulations_executed']is False and r['synthesis_executed']is False
          assert r['terminal_source_pins_unchanged']is True
          p=r['publication_controls']
          assert len(p['release']['rejected'])==17
          assert len(p['wait']['positive_cases'])==3 and len(p['wait']['rejected'])==4
          assert p['archive']['negative_controls']==6 and p['archive']['positive_roundtrip']
          assert p['readonly_program']['actual_extracted_program_positive']
          assert len(p['readonly_program']['rejected'])==3 and not p['readonly_program']['network_or_upload_executed']
          PY
      - name: Preserve complete small source-control result in bounded log chunks
        if: always()
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --log-controls
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: gen12-record-cdc-controls-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc
            cdc-controls-console.log
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn
  complete-functional-proof:
    needs: source-controls
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.execute
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bounded exact tools, two RTL simulators, mapped oracle and eighteen compiled faults
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: |
          python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --native | tee cdc-native-console.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          r=json.loads(Path('hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc/result.json').read_text())
          assert r['status']=='PASS_RECORD_CDC_66_RTL_33_MAPPED_18_COMPILED_FAULTS'
          assert r['engineering_accepted']is True and r['terminal_source_pins_unchanged']is True
          assert len(r['rtl'])==12 and sum(len(x['tests'])for x in r['rtl'])==66
          assert len(r['mapped'])==6 and sum(len(x['tests'])for x in r['mapped'])==33
          assert all(t['disposition']=='PASS'for x in r['rtl']+r['mapped']for t in x['tests'])
          assert len(r['synthesis'])==6 and all(x['full_synth_and_check']for x in r['synthesis'])
          assert len(r['mutations'])==18 and len({x['mutation']for x in r['mutations']})==18
          assert all(x['compile_returncode']==0 and x['run_returncode']!=0 and
                     sum(t['disposition']=='DETECTED_ASSERTION'for t in x['tests'])==1 for x in r['mutations'])
          assert all(value is False for value in r['scope'].values())
          PY
      - name: Preserve complete small result before artifact upload
        if: always()
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --log-result
      - name: Publish exact-source summary and complete verified evidence parts
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 -u scripts/cloud_pcie_gen12_record_cdc.py --publish
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: gen12-record-cdc-proof-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc
            hw/soc/out/cloud-pcie-gen12-record-cdc-publication
            cdc-native-console.log
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn
